unit_definition: routing units per 1,000,000 tokens; 100 units = 1 USD in this repository estimator
source_policy: Engineering snapshot checked against GitHub Copilot's official models-and-pricing table. Revalidate before financial reporting because rates, tiers, thresholds, and supported models can change.
notes: Pricing models may be a superset of the active route so historical/disabled models can remain priced without becoming routable.
Each model can have one or more arbitrary named pricing tiers selected by min_context_tokens.
When provider telemetry exposes exact context_tokens, pass it explicitly. The estimator otherwise conservatively counts fresh + cached + cache-write tokens as input context.
